New York's Diamond District: Botswana's VP says doubt over its De Beers partnership, not price, let lab-grown gain share.

Ndaba Gaolathe spoke at Chatham House on 17 September as Anglo sells its 85% stake in De Beers; Botswana keeps 15%. "Diamonds can remain part of Botswana's future without remaining the sole architect," he said.

Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.
